resumeText:
Neha Iyer | Bengaluru | neha.iyer@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Motion Designer, Indigo Byte Fintech, Bengaluru (2022 - present)
- Animated onboarding screens and payment success states in After Effects for the mobile app.
- Exported the animations as Lottie files with Bodymovin and checked them with app developers.
- Drew storyboards and style frames for three product launch explainer videos.
- Prepared layered vector assets in Adobe Illustrator for every animation.
- Applied typography and colour theory to kinetic type for festive brand campaigns.
- Presented motion concepts to product managers and brand leads in sprint reviews.

Junior Graphic Designer, Brightline Studio, Bengaluru (2020 - 2022)
- Designed social media creatives and print brochures for retail clients.

EDUCATION
BDes Communication Design, Srishti Manipal Institute, Bengaluru, 2020

SKILLS
After Effects, Lottie, Illustrator, Photoshop, Figma
